content.text: {"id": "mm6949a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among 14 participating states, the age-adjusted AI/AN COVID-19 mortality rate"}, {"loc": "table 1", "q": "AI/AN:White rate ratio (95% CI)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The age-adjusted AI/AN COVID-19 mortality rate (55.8 deaths per 100,000)"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "35.1% of AI/AN COVID-19–associated deaths were among persons aged <60 years, compared with 6.3%"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The age-adjusted AI/AN COVID-19 mortality rate (55.8 deaths per 100,000)"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "age-adjusted COVID-19–associated mortality among AI/ANs was 1.8 times that among non-Hispanic Whites"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The largest differences were among persons in the three age groups encompassing 20–49 years."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "conducted for public health surveillance purposes"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Death rates by race/ethnicity were age-adjusted to the 2000 U.S. standard population"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "95% CIs for rates were calculated using the Byar approximation to the Poisson distribution"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "COVID-19 death rates among AI/AN were compared with those among White persons using rate ratios."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The number of deaths among persons aged <20 years was small (<10), and these data were suppressed"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The analytic methods used did not account for clustering of deaths by state."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
